Customize Graphical Expectation-Maximization Parameters




To create a Graph-EM reconstruction, adjust the options below and click "submit." You will receive an email when your reconstruction is done.

For more information about each of the options, mouse over the question mark icons or see Guillot et al. 2015 for more details. Default values will produce a reconstruction similar to the one in this tutorial. If you are unsure what an option does, leaving it at its default value is a good choice.

GitHub Login Required

Login with GitHub to submit your reconstruction. Results will be stored in a new repository in your GitHub account.

Login with GitHub
Why does PReSto need this permission?
PReSto creates your reconstruction in a new repository in your GitHub account. To do that, GitHub requires the public_repo permission, which technically grants read/write access to all of your public repositories — GitHub's OAuth does not allow scoping access to a single repo. Your private repositories remain inaccessible. PReSto only reads and writes the new repository it creates for you. You can revoke access at any time at github.com/settings/applications.
